task.prompt: Fix the inclusive range check without changing the tests. After editing, run `npm test` to verify the final result.

checks.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {inRange} from './src/in-range.js'; const cases = [[3, 3, 8, true], [8, 3, 8, true], [5, 3, 8, true], [2, 3, 8, false], [9, 3, 8, false]]; for (const [value, min, max, expected] of cases) { const actual = inRange(value, min, max); if (actual !== expected) { console.error({value, min, max, expected, actual}); process.exit(1); } }"
